name: Festival Stone of Thistledown
title: Festival Stone of Thistledown
summary: 'The Stone of Thistledown overlooks Cragstone Falls from the western bank ... Obviously, the Empyrean appreciated the magnificence of the view' (Alatar Locke). In the kit the Festival Stone and its Anniversary glow stand on the bluff (z 44) 100 m south-west of the falls between two 5.5 m ancient columns crowned with fire bowls (flames at z 49.7-49.9) and an exploration marker; the bluff falls north to the river plateau and east to Victory Bay.

landmarks.note: Festival Stone spawn with the Anniversary glow 8 m above.

landmarks.name: Cragstone Falls
landmarks.note: 90 m-wide falls 85 m north-east (separate site poi-cragstone-falls).

site.name: Festival Stone of Thistledown
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer thistledown-festival-stone (10 m south of the stone on the bluff, z 44).

shots.standingOrder: Rise 9 m from just above the grass behind the Thistledown stone and its two burning pillars until Cragstone Falls and the bay appear beyond the bluff edge; stay 5 m from the pillars and 3 m from every bush.
shots.notes: Pedestal reveal: the lens starts 2 m above the bluff grass 20 m SSW of the Thistledown Festival Stone, its two ancient columns topped with fire bowls (flames at z 49.7-49.9) and the Anniversary glow filling the frame, and rises 9 m while tilting down to hold the stone: Cragstone Falls' lip and the northern half of the falls (proj.mjs: lip clear from t=2, north falls from t=6) and Victory Bay appear over the bluff edge. Sun SE behind-right.
